alice: Thursday window 10:00-12:00 PT — owners please confirm deploy times & smoke readiness for services: inference-runtime, api-gateway, models-catalog, console. TL;DR: who is on deploy, who runs smoke, rollback flagged? @here

brian: runtime — I'm owner. planning 10:15 slot, i'll run smoke. rollback branch: revert/runtime-hotfix. i'll be on-call during window.

carla: api-gateway — prefer 10:00 to avoid traffic spike. i'll be deploy lead and smoke runner. @devops-bot can you reserve 10:00 slot?

devops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled api-gateway at 10:00 PT, inference-runtime at 10:15 PT, console at 10:30 PT, models-catalog at 11:00 PT. canary observers notified.

jules: models-catalog — small metadata push, 11:00 works. smoke will be index + /models/health check. i'll coordinate with infra.

sam: console — aiming 10:30. smoke will be quick UI sanity + api ping. rollback tag ready: console-v2-rollback.

alice: Thanks all. Quick smoke checklist (copy/paste):
- Run `./scripts/smoke.sh <service>` -> expect: OK
- Check dashboards: infra/latency, errors, model-qps
- Verify canary error rate <5% for 5m or rollback
- Post commit SHA + smoke result in this thread
Can each owner drop a short ack when they've run smoke during the window?

brian: ack — will post `smoke: PASS` + sha when done. :thumbsup:

carla: ack — will signal `smoke: PASS` or `smoke: FAIL`. will also post quick curl snippet if anything odd.

jules: ack — running `curl -s https://catalog.internal/models/health | jq .status` as part of smoke. will post output.

sam: ack — coordinating console smoke with UX on-call, will post screenshots if UI flaps.

alice: One more: if any auto-fallback or error spike triggers, tag rollback and ping #eng-oncall immediately. attach the commit SHA in your smoke reply so we can trace. Thanks — i'll watch the release window channel and triage if needed.
